newsitem.title: USA: US chain store sales off 0.1 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: US chain store sales off 0.1 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 0.1 percent in the week ended October 5 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 2.8 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index slipped 1.3 percent from the prior month.

"The latest week's sales generally remained sluggish for most retailers although some retailers noted that although their week's sales were planned to be down, they were not as weak as planned," a BTM/Schroders report said.
